message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on loaded signals or labels; data is read and used directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote fetching, and no checksums or integrity verification are implemented anywhere in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps labels via dictionary lookups and counts label distributions for examination, but performs no checks for label-flipping anomalies, label noise detection, or validation against an expected label set before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs signal resampling and reshaping but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates model classes (RTACNN, ResNet, CPSCWinnerNet, CNN, WaveletModel) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized models.

No detected label distribution validation: The code calls examine_database() which counts label distributions but this is not invoked in the training pipeline; no class balance check or anomaly detection on labels is performed before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism present in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD routines are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, cryptographic hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed before signals are passed to the model; the pipeline loads and processes data directly without any defensive checks.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no visible checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or calibrated thresholds anywhere in the inference data-flow path shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an ECG signal classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
